pattern: ような気がする（ようなきがする）
purpose: Express a tentative impression rather than a confident claim.
keywords: Plain form + ような気がする; noun + の / な-adjective + な + ような気がする
I feel as though we have met before.
It seems a little warmer today.
I have a feeling this method is easier.
formation: Plain form + ような気がする; noun + の / な-adjective + な + ような気がする
restrictions: Often based on memory, sensation, or an uncertain intuition.
mistake: It weakens the claim; it does not provide evidence that the impression is true.
